title: Goat Collar with Copper Bell – Adjustable for Small Livestock
descriptionHtml:
Losing track of your animals in the pasture?

Goats, sheep and small livestock move fast and love to hide in bushes and rough terrain. Without sound they're hard to keep track of – and a runaway goat can take hours to find.

Hear where your animals are – all the time

The collar with a copper bell means you can always hear where the animal is, even out of sight. The adjustable, hard-wearing polyester strap sits comfortably and securely on goats, sheep and other smaller farm animals.

Features

  • Copper bell – clear sound, hear the animal from a distance.
  • Adjustable – fits different neck sizes.
  • Hard-wearing polyester – withstands wind and weather.
  • For goats, sheep and small livestock.

Change of Mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
